Architecture Decision Record template

For retrospective records, use rationale supported by issues, PRs, documentation,
commits, or contemporaneous discussion. Do not infer historical motivations from
current code. A retrospective record does not imply the ADR existed at the time.

---

# ADR-NNNN: <decision>

Status: Proposed | Accepted | Superseded
Date: YYYY-MM-DD
Retrospective: yes/no

## Context

What problem or architectural pressure caused this decision?

## Decision

What are we committing to?

## Consequences

What becomes easier or harder? What remains unverified or outside scope?

## Alternatives

Include only alternatives known from issues, PRs, existing docs, or discussion.

## References

Relevant issues, PRs, specs, architecture documents, or decision discussion.
